pokeemerald:ITEM_TM_STEEL_WING.text: Spreads hard- edged wings and slams into the foe.

pokeemerald:ITEM_TM_SKILL_SWAP.text: Switches abilities with the foe on the turn this is used.

pokeemerald:ITEM_TM_SNATCH.text: Steals the effects of the move the foe is trying to use.

pokeemerald:ITEM_TM_OVERHEAT.text: Enables full-power attack, but sharply lowers SP. ATK.

pokeemerald:ITEM_HM_CUT.text: Attacks the foe with sharp blades or claws.

pokeemerald:ITEM_HM_FLY.text: Flies up on the first turn, then attacks next turn.

pokeemerald:ITEM_HM_SURF.text: Creates a huge wave, then crashes it down on the foe.

pokeemerald:ITEM_HM_STRENGTH.text: Builds enormous power, then slams the foe.

pokeemerald:ITEM_HM_FLASH.text: Looses a powerful blast of light that reduces accuracy.

pokeemerald:ITEM_HM_ROCK_SMASH.text: A rock-crushingly tough attack that may lower DEFENSE.

pokeemerald:ITEM_HM_WATERFALL.text: Attacks the foe with enough power to climb waterfalls.

pokeemerald:ITEM_HM_DIVE.text: Dives underwater the 1st turn, then attacks next turn.

pokeemerald:ITEM_OAKS_PARCEL.text: A parcel for PROF. OAK from a POKéMON MART's clerk.

pokeemerald:ITEM_POKE_FLUTE.text: A sweet-sounding flute that awakens POKéMON.

pokeemerald:ITEM_SECRET_KEY.text: The key to the CINNABAR ISLAND GYM's entrance.

pokeemerald:ITEM_BIKE_VOUCHER.text: A voucher for obtaining a bicycle from the BIKE SHOP.

pokeemerald:ITEM_GOLD_TEETH.text: Gold dentures lost by the SAFARI ZONE's WARDEN.

pokeemerald:ITEM_OLD_AMBER.text: A stone containing the genes of an ancient POKéMON.

pokeemerald:ITEM_CARD_KEY.text: A card-type door key used in SILPH CO's office.

pokeemerald:ITEM_LIFT_KEY.text: An elevator key used in TEAM ROCKET's HIDEOUT.

pokeemerald:ITEM_HELIX_FOSSIL.text: A piece of an ancient marine POKéMON's seashell.

pokeemerald:ITEM_DOME_FOSSIL.text: A piece of an ancient marine POKéMON's shell.

pokeemerald:ITEM_SILPH_SCOPE.text: SILPH CO's scope makes unseeable POKéMON visible.

pokeemerald:ITEM_BICYCLE.text: A folding bicycle that is faster than the RUNNING SHOES.

pokeemerald:ITEM_TOWN_MAP.text: Can be viewed anytime. Shows your present location.

pokeemerald:ITEM_VS_SEEKER.text: A rechargeable unit that flags battle- ready TRAINERS.

pokeemerald:ITEM_FAME_CHECKER.text: Stores information on famous people for instant recall.

pokeemerald:ITEM_TM_CASE.text: A convenient case that holds TMs and HMs.

pokeemerald:ITEM_BERRY_POUCH.text: A convenient container that holds BERRIES.

pokeemerald:ITEM_TEACHY_TV.text: A TV set tuned to an advice program for TRAINERS.

pokeemerald:ITEM_TRI_PASS.text: A pass for ferries between ONE, TWO, and THREE ISLAND.

pokeemerald:ITEM_RAINBOW_PASS.text: For ferries serving VERMILION and the SEVII ISLANDS.

pokeemerald:ITEM_TEA.text: A thirst-quenching tea prepared by an old lady.

pokeemerald:ITEM_MYSTIC_TICKET.text: A ticket required to board the ship to NAVEL ROCK.

pokeemerald:ITEM_AURORA_TICKET.text: A ticket required to board the ship to BIRTH ISLAND.

pokeemerald:ITEM_POWDER_JAR.text: Stores BERRY POWDER made using a BERRY CRUSHER.

pokeemerald:ITEM_RUBY.text: An exquisite, red- glowing gem that symbolizes passion.

pokeemerald:ITEM_SAPPHIRE.text: A brilliant blue gem that symbolizes honesty.

pokeemerald:ITEM_MAGMA_EMBLEM.text: A medal-like item in the same shape as TEAM MAGMA's mark.

pokeemerald:ITEM_OLD_SEA_MAP.text: A faded sea chart that shows the way to a certain island.
